name: pifi-finance
description: PiFi — co-operative / NBFC finance back-office (rebuild). backend/ and frontend/ are two independent projects.

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
